newsitem.title: USA: Seagate says to repurchase up to 7 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Seagate says to repurchase up to 7 mln shrs.

text.p: Seagate Technology Inc said on its board had approved a stock repurchase program pursuant to which up to 7,000,000 shares of its common stock may be acquired in the open market.
As of September 5, 1996, Seagate had approximately 107,000,000 shares of common stock outstanding.

President and chief executive Alan Shugart said in a statement that "the decision was made in view of the prices at which the Company's Common Stock has recently traded which we believe do not reflect the true long-term value of the company."
The company the stock repurchase program will also provide shares to be issued under employee stock plans, reducing dilution from the plans.
